candidate_relations.reason: Although generalized joint hypermobility, doughy skin, piezogenic papules, and pes planus can resemble hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, the benchmark diagnosis is molecularly confirmed LDS5 due to pathogenic TGFB3 c.427A>T (p.Arg143*) variant.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct heritable connective-tissue disorder rather than TGFB3-related Loeys-Dietz syndrome type 5.
